facts.text: In 1886 the cornerstone was laid at the intersection of High Street and Summit Place for the three-story building later named Weston Hall, in honor of the institution's early benefactor.
Two years after Cullimore Hall was built in 1958, the old Weston Hall was razed and replaced with the current seven-story structure.
Edward Weston was a founding member of the board of trustees of the school that became NJIT. Weston Hall is named for him and his son, Edward Faraday Weston.
Edward Weston obtained more than 300 patents. His Weston Electric Light Company in Newark won the contract to illuminate the Brooklyn Bridge.
High Street in Newark was renamed Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard.
